text:
Rough estimate

Basic prototype: About 1–4 hours elapsed time and 1–3 hours of human input.
Tested, deployable application: About 1–3 working days elapsed time and 2–8 hours of human input.

This assumes a few screens, a simple data model and workflow, standard authentication, no custom integrations, and minimal approval requirements. Complex security, external systems, data migration, or unclear requirements can extend the work to several days or weeks.

Platform not identified: The platform’s actual automation and build speed cannot be confirmed, so these are general low-code or AI-assisted development ranges rather than a platform-specific quote.
limitations: The platform and exact application scope are unspecified.
